## Checklist

- [ ] `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, and `bun run lint` pass locally
- [ ] `bun run docs:gen:check` passes (docs in sync with source)
- [ ] Changeset added (`bun run changeset`) if this ships in the published package
- [ ] Behavior verified on the affected platform(s): iOS / Android / web
- [ ] Styling follows the kit rules: semantic boolean props, no `style` overrides
      at call sites, no web-only escape hatches (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
